settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Use one model for chat, translation and scanned PDF recognition.
settings.keepKey: Leave empty to keep the saved key
settings.privacy: Keys are encrypted on the server. Model requests need internet and may incur provider charges. Scanned pages require a vision model.

settings.noTelemetry: This deployment has no telemetry service. Reading statistics stay on this device.
settings.importIntoWorkspace: Import local files into your cloud workspace. You can also do this later from Import.

conflicts.title: Resolve conflicts
conflicts.identicalHint: Archive copies with identical content and file types. Different versions stay here for review.
conflicts.batchFailed: Could not resolve {{count}} conflicts. Their copies were kept; retry or review them individually.
conflicts.description: Compare the saved versions and choose the content to keep.
conflicts.identical: Both versions have the same text.
conflicts.binary: This file cannot be compared as text here. Download both versions to review, then choose one.
conflicts.hint: Your choice applies to the original file. Both versions are archived in your backup. If the file changes during review, reopen it and compare again.
